summary: The row or column of tabs. It is one stop in the Tab order, and the arrow keys move among its tabs.

orientation.description: vertical stacks the tabs, and the up and down arrows move among them.

root.note: A tray: the same paint as a switch's off track.

thumb.note: The face of the selected tab, never the solid face. It takes the box of the selected tab, its anchor, and moves to the next one selected (C32). Drawn as a pseudo-element, so it is in place before the elements are defined.

keys.ArrowRight, ArrowLeft: In a horizontal list, move focus to the next or the previous tab, following the writing direction, and wrap at the ends.
keys.ArrowDown, ArrowUp: In a vertical list, the same.
keys.Home, End: Move focus to the first or the last tab.
keys.Tab: Enters the list at the selected tab and leaves it with the next press.

guidance.text: The author names the list with aria-label or aria-labelledby.
